title: NFL Live Field Configuration
description: An arcade-style live NFL show: an animated field, collectible player cards with photos and stats, and touchdown bursts, optionally locked to your favorite teams. No API key needed.

favorite_teams.title: Favorite Teams
favorite_teams.description: Select your favorite NFL teams. Their games come first and get extra turns, and their players' cards lead. Turn on 'Lock to favorites' to show only their games.

lock_to_favorites.description: Favorites lock: show ONLY live games that involve one of your favorite teams. Off shows favorites first, then every other live game. With no favorite teams selected there is nothing to lock to, so every live game shows

lock_fallback_to_all.description: When the lock is on and none of your teams is playing, show the other live games until yours kick off (off = show nothing and let the display move on)

live_game_duration.description: Seconds the animated field screen stays up for each live game

cards_per_game.description: Player cards after each game's field screen: the game's best performers (passing, rushing, receiving leaders), your favorites' players first. 0 turns the cards off

card_seconds.description: Seconds each player card stays up

favorite_live_boost.description: Turns your favorites' games get for every 1 turn other live games get (ignored when the lock is on). 1 = even rotation

live_priority.description: Let live games take over the rotation while they are on

show_headshots.description: Show ESPN player photos on the cards and bursts. When off, cards show a team-colour silhouette with the jersey number

score_alerts.description: Interrupt the rotation with a touchdown / field goal burst (sunburst, confetti, the scorer's photo) when a favorite team scores

show_recent.description: Show recently finished games (final score, with the same player cards) in their own rotation

recent_game_duration.description: Seconds on the final-score screen for each recent game

recent_cards_per_game.description: Player cards after each recent game's final score (0 = none)

show_upcoming.description: Show games that haven't kicked off yet: matchup and kickoff time, in their own rotation

upcoming_game_duration.description: Seconds on each upcoming game's preview screen

game_limits.title: Recent / upcoming game limits
game_limits.description: How many recent and upcoming games to show, and how favorites are weighted among them. Matches the selection settings the repo's other scoreboards use.

recent_games_to_show.description: Your favorite teams' recent games to include

upcoming_games_to_show.description: Your favorite teams' upcoming games to include

other_recent_games_to_show.description: Non-favorite recent games to include, from a slice that rotates over time

other_upcoming_games_to_show.description: Non-favorite upcoming games to include, from a slice that rotates over time

other_rotation_interval_seconds.description: How often the non-favorite slice advances to the next games in the schedule

favorite_rotation_boost.description: Turns a favorite's recent/upcoming game gets per 1 turn of another game

spoiler_delay_seconds.description: Hold scores, cards and bursts back this many seconds, for watching on a delayed stream

exclude_teams.description: Teams to always hide from the live rotation (spoiler protection when you watch on a delay). Beats every other setting, including the favorites lock

celebrate_all_teams.description: Also show the score burst when any other team scores, not just favorites

display_duration.description: Seconds for the mode when nothing is live

live_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between score refreshes while a game is live

idle_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between refreshes when no game is live

request_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for ESPN before giving up

alert_seconds.description: How long each score burst stays up

animations.description: Animate the screens (count-up, bar fills, foil shimmer, marching drive arrows, confetti). Off draws each screen once, which is lighter on an older Pi

animation_fps.description: Frames per second for the animations

headshot_downloads.description: Download player photos from ESPN. Off uses only photos already saved

test_mode.description: Show made-up live games with leaders, photos and a touchdown burst every few updates, instead of real data, to try the look and the favorites lock offline
